verdict.rationale: Klaviyo exposes a full REST API with endpoints for campaigns, profiles, events, and reporting, plus a documented official MCP server explicitly described as helping with tasks 'from campaign creation to flow performance reports,' enabling an agent to programmatically pull audiences, automations, and campaign results. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server actually retrieving live automation and campaign-result data end-to-end, and clearer documentation of audience/segment export specifics via MCP.
